why: A (universes 0) is only the unfolding of the project's DEFINITION pathTangent hN c (a Submodule of ℝ → V: piecewise smooth X, tangent to N along c on [0,1], X 0 = X 1 = 0) — mem_pathTangent is Iff.rfl — and its dependence on c|[0,1]; so B ⇒ A is proved only by proving A outright (vacuous). B: for every abstract connected Riemannian ℝⁿ-manifold, Ω(M;p,q) ≠ ∅ for all p, q (piecewise smooth paths on [0,1]) and TΩ_ω (fields along ω, continuous in TM on [0,1], smooth along each piece of some subdivision, vanishing at 0, 1) contains 0 and is closed under sums and scalar multiples. A ⇒ B fails genuinely: B is about abstract manifolds (not embedded), and its content — piecewise-smooth path-connectedness of connected manifolds and the vector-space structure of TΩ — is not stated by A; in the project the vector-space structure is built into the definition (Submodule), and nonemptiness of Ω for connected N is only implicit in riemDist_ne_top. B is provable outright (common refinement of subdivisions, smoothness of fibrewise sums, chart-segment path-connectedness) but that is abstract-manifold work unrelated to A.
